name: shoply
description: Shoply - Fullstack Multi-Purpose E-commerce Platform with Telegram Bot and Standalone Admin

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT,ADMIN" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run server" "npm run client" "npm run admin"
scripts.build:prod: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run prisma:push && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix admin install && npm --prefix admin run build
scripts.build:render: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run prisma:generate:postgres && npm --prefix server run prisma:push:postgres && npm --prefix server run seed && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix admin install && npm --prefix admin run build
